_rule: The storage peer's content search recipe (elohim_epr_index::fuse::Recipe, rrf-v2): reciprocal-rank fusion for ORDER over one producer, lexical — the bm25 ranking of the content-lexical-index fold named by measure. Compiled into elohim-storage (include_str!) and validated at boot. The recipe CID every answer prints is atom_cid over the addressed keys only — recipe, k, order_only, producers; lens_table has its own CID (atom_cid of the table, printed as the lens cid) and measure is addressed by the measure's own CID, so neither moves the recipe's address, and no underscore key is addressed. lens_table is the learning app's own: minimal 5, standard 20, whole 100 candidates; a level the table does not declare resolves to its default, never a refusal. candidate_headroom bounds the WORK, not the ranking: the fused set is cut to (offset + limit) * candidate_headroom (never below the lens's choice_count) before the join and the reach gate, so a public question cannot buy a corpus-sized walk with an authorizer call per row, and the cut is named in omissions. It is a serving bound this peer applies, not part of the method's identity — two peers with different headroom rank the same fused set in the same order — so like lens_table it is NOT addressed by the recipe CID.
